segments.text: Scrollcraft is a clawed code skill for building scroll-driven sites without recycling the same landing page skeleton. It chooses from eight
incompatible page grammarss, plans one visual peak, and requires a signature interaction plus a fingerprint check against earlier builds. Scroll becomes
the animation timeline while a headless browser pass hunts for dead scrolling, unreadable contrast, faded copy, and broken
